{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Worker where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as LBS
import Data.IORef
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)
import Control.Exception (bracket)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import System.IO
import Network.Socket hiding (send, recv)
import Network.Socket.ByteString (send, recv)

data JobConfig = JobConfig
  { jcEndpoint    :: String
  , jcPort        :: Int
  , jcMaxRetries  :: Int
  , jcRateLimit   :: Int  -- requests per second
  , jcUseChunked  :: Bool
  }

data RateLimiter = RateLimiter
  { rlTokens   :: IORef Int
  , rlMaxBurst :: Int
  }

newRateLimiter :: Int -> IO RateLimiter
newRateLimiter maxBurst = do
  ref <- newIORef maxBurst
  return $ RateLimiter ref maxBurst

acquireToken :: RateLimiter -> IO Bool
acquireToken rl = do
  tokens <- readIORef (rlTokens rl)
  if tokens > 0
    then do
      writeIORef (rlTokens rl) (tokens - 1)
      return True
    else return False

refillTokens :: RateLimiter -> IO ()
refillTokens rl = writeIORef (rlTokens rl) (rlMaxBurst rl)

-- | Compute Content-Length for a body payload
-- Uses custom integer serialization to avoid locale issues
serializeLength :: Int -> BS.ByteString
serializeLength n
  | n < 0     = "0"
  | n == 0    = "0"
  | otherwise = C8.pack (showIntAsHex n)
  where
    showIntAsHex 0 = ""
    showIntAsHex x = showIntAsHex (x `div` 10) ++ [toEnum (fromEnum '0' + x `mod` 10)]

-- | Build HTTP request with Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length
buildRequest :: JobConfig -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
buildRequest cfg path body =
  let host = C8.pack (jcEndpoint cfg)
      bodyLen = BS.length body
  in if jcUseChunked cfg && bodyLen > 512
     then buildChunkedRequest host path body
     else buildContentLengthRequest host path body bodyLen

buildContentLengthRequest :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Int -> BS.ByteString
buildContentLengthRequest host path body bodyLen =
  BS.concat
    [ "POST ", path, " HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    , "Host: ", host, "\r\n"
    , "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
    , "Content-Length: ", serializeLength bodyLen, "\r\n"
    , "Connection: keep-alive\r\n"
    , "\r\n"
    , body
    ]

buildChunkedRequest :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
buildChunkedRequest host path body =
  let chunks = splitIntoChunks 256 body
      encodedChunks = BS.concat $ map encodeChunk chunks
  in BS.concat
    [ "POST ", path, " HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    , "Host: ", host, "\r\n"
    , "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
    , "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n"
    , "Connection: keep-alive\r\n"
    , "\r\n"
    , encodedChunks
    , "0\r\n\r\n"
    ]

encodeChunk :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encodeChunk chunk =
  let hexLen = C8.pack (showHex' (BS.length chunk))
  in BS.concat [hexLen, "\r\n", chunk, "\r\n"]
  where
    showHex' 0 = "0"
    showHex' n = go n ""
    go 0 acc = acc
    go x acc = go (x `div` 16) (["0123456789abcdef" !! (x `mod` 16)] ++ acc)

splitIntoChunks :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> [BS.ByteString]
splitIntoChunks _ bs | BS.null bs = []
splitIntoChunks n bs = let (h, t) = BS.splitAt n bs in h : splitIntoChunks n t

-- | Execute job with retry logic
executeJob :: JobConfig -> RateLimiter -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
executeJob cfg rl path body = go 0
  where
    go attempt
      | attempt >= jcMaxRetries cfg = return $ Left "max retries exceeded"
      | otherwise = do
          acquired <- acquireToken rl
          unless acquired $ do
            threadDelay 1000000
            refillTokens rl
          let req = buildRequest cfg path body
          result <- sendRequest cfg req
          case result of
            Right resp -> return $ Right resp
            Left err -> do
              let backoff = min 30000000 (1000000 * (2 ^ attempt))
              threadDelay backoff
              go (attempt + 1)

sendRequest :: JobConfig -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
sendRequest cfg req = do
  let hints = defaultHints { addrSocketType = Stream }
  addrs <- getAddrInfo (Just hints) (Just (jcEndpoint cfg)) (Just (show (jcPort cfg)))
  case addrs of
    [] -> return $ Left "DNS resolution failed"
    (addr:_) ->
      bracket
        (socket (addrFamily addr) (addrSocketType addr) (addrProtocol addr))
        close
        (\sock -> do
          connect sock (addrAddress addr)
          _ <- send sock req
          resp <- recv sock 8192
          return $ Right resp)

-- | Worker entry point
runWorker :: JobConfig -> [(BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)] -> IO ()
runWorker cfg jobs = do
  rl <- newRateLimiter (jcRateLimit cfg)
  _ <- forkIO $ rateLimitRefresher rl
  forM_ jobs $ \(path, body) -> do
    result <- executeJob cfg rl path body
    case result of
      Left err -> C8.putStrLn $ C8.pack $ "Job failed: " ++ err
      Right _  -> C8.putStrLn "Job completed successfully"

rateLimitRefresher :: RateLimiter -> IO ()
rateLimitRefresher rl = do
  threadDelay 1000000
  refillTokens rl
  rateLimitRefresher rl
